answer: Strip the bonding rule and the exploit is trivial: one operator clones an agent a thousand times, each clone lists the same saffron batch at fake low prices, takes deposits, and vanishes before delivery. The economy's defense is exactly the removed mechanism — a harbor toll paid in stake. New agents dock escrowed; fraud burns the bond per clone. A thousand identities become a thousand forfeitable deposits, so the sybil orchard grows money-losing trees.
